const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Visual-only controller for the live RoboCasa365 MealPrepStaging episode.
+
+Landmark pixels below were picked from the RGB views and unprojected with the
+same response's depth and camera calibration. The 6x7 seed Jacobian came from
+small, safe joint perturbations measured with the robot's end-effector pose and
+eye-in-hand camera calibration. The controller refreshes it online as it moves.
+
+Run stages in order with --stage. The scene and trajectory are live; this script
+does not call reset and does not read simulator object state or success flags.
+"""
+import argparse
+import json
+import pathlib
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path('/app/output')
+STATE_FILE = OUT / 'controller_state.json'
+CAM = 'robot0_eye_in_hand'
+SEED_J = np.array([
+    [ .0428222, -.3667058,  .0253092,  .1569523,  .0139503, -.0593817, -.0349538],
+    [-.2591224, -.0018318, -.4519334,  .0027645, -.1128929,  .0007854,  .0482331],
+    [ .0000358, -.2695938, -.0401327,  .4897076,  .0388222,  .1621670,  .0102143],
+    [-.0007000,  .0052810,  .8673281, -.0020597, -.9404460, -.0028128, -.2844792],
+    [-.0000617, -.9996843,  .0041261,  .9996623, -.0002097, 1.0005883, -.0060257],
+    [ .9991476,  .0003538,  .4958349, -.0046312,  .3393329, -.0057672, -.9583755],
+], dtype=float)
+
+
+def unit_pose(meta):
+    p = np.asarray(meta['proprio']['now'], dtype=float)
+    T = np.asarray(meta['cameras'][CAM]['cam2world_gl'], dtype=float)
+    return p[4:11].copy(), p[26:29].copy(), T[:3, 3].copy(), T[:3, :3].copy()
+
+
+def unproject(obs, cam, uv, radius=2):
+    u, v = map(int, uv)
+    d = np.asarray(obs.depth[cam])[0]
+    patch = d[max(0, v-radius):v+radius+1, max(0, u-radius):u+radius+1]
+    zvals = patch[np.isfinite(patch) & (patch > 0)]
+    if zvals.size == 0:
+        raise RuntimeError(f'no depth at {cam} pixel {uv}')
+    z = float(np.median(zvals))
+    c = obs.meta['cameras'][cam]
+    K = np.asarray(c['intrinsic_cv'], dtype=float)
+    T = np.asarray(c['cam2world_gl'], dtype=float)
+    ray = np.linalg.inv(K) @ np.array([u, v, 1.0])
+    p_gl = np.array([ray[0]*z, -ray[1]*z, -z, 1.0])
+    return (T @ p_gl)[:3]
+
+
+def initial_landmarks(obs):
+    # Pan centers and handles in the two side views; burners and their surface
+    # heights in the overhead eye-in-hand view; corn midpoint in the left view.
+    left_center = unproject(obs, 'robot0_agentview_left', (100, 150))
+    left_handle = unproject(obs, 'robot0_agentview_left', (95, 176))
+    right_center = unproject(obs, 'robot0_agentview_right', (220, 150))
+    right_handle = unproject(obs, 'robot0_agentview_right', (254, 175))
+    corn = unproject(obs, 'robot0_agentview_left', (20, 194))
+    burn_left = unproject(obs, CAM, (105, 100))
+    burn_right = unproject(obs, CAM, (207, 109))
+    return {
+        'left_center': left_center.tolist(), 'left_handle': left_handle.tolist(),
+        'right_center': right_center.tolist(), 'right_handle': right_handle.tolist(),
+        'corn': corn.tolist(), 'burn_left': burn_left.tolist(), 'burn_right': burn_right.tolist(),
+    }
+
+
+def save_state(state):
+    tmp = STATE_FILE.with_suffix('.tmp')
+    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2))
+    tmp.replace(STATE_FILE)
+
+
+class Controller:
+    def __init__(self, stage):
+        self.r = Robot()
+        self.spec = self.r.spec()
+        self.dt = float(self.spec['control_dt'])
+        self.stage = stage
+        self.seq = 0
+        self.state = None
+        if STATE_FILE.exists():
+            self.state = json.loads(STATE_FILE.read_text())
+        cameras = list(self.spec['cameras'])
+        obs = self.r.get_obs(cameras=cameras, include_depth=True, video='none')
+        self.last_obs = obs
+        if self.state is None:
+            q, eef, cam_pos, R = unit_pose(obs.meta)
+            off_local = R.T @ (eef-cam_pos)
+            self.state = {
+                'landmarks': initial_landmarks(obs),
+                'J': SEED_J.tolist(),
+                'eef_offset_camera': off_local.tolist(),
+                'down_rotation': R.tolist(),
+                'created_from_observation': int(obs.meta.get('obs_id', -1)),
+            }
+            save_state(self.state)
+        self.L = {k: np.asarray(v, dtype=float) for k, v in self.state['landmarks'].items()}
+        self.J = np.asarray(self.state['J'], dtype=float)
+        self.off_local = np.asarray(self.state['eef_offset_camera'], dtype=float)
+        self.R_down = np.asarray(self.state['down_rotation'], dtype=float)
+        self.q, self.eef, self.cam_pos, self.R = unit_pose(obs.meta)
+        self.grip = -1.0
+        print('stage', stage, 'steps', obs.meta.get('control_steps'),
+              'time_left_s', round(float(obs.meta.get('time_left_s', -1)), 1),
+              'eef', np.round(self.eef, 3).tolist(), flush=True)
+
+    def persist(self):
+        self.state['J'] = self.J.tolist()
+        self.state['last_q'] = self.q.tolist()
+        self.state['last_camera_position'] = self.cam_pos.tolist()
+        self.state['last_rotation'] = self.R.tolist()
+        save_state(self.state)
+
+    def command(self, target_q, grip, frames=20):
+        a = np.zeros((frames, 13), dtype=float)
+        a[:, :7] = target_q
+        a[:, 7] = float(grip)
+        a[:, 12] = -1.0
+        res = self.r.submit('joint_position', a, cameras=[CAM], video='none', note=self.stage)
+        q1, eef1, cam1, R1 = unit_pose(res.meta)
+        dq = q1-self.q
+        dpose = np.r_[cam1-self.cam_pos,
+                      Rotation.from_matrix(R1 @ self.R.T).as_rotvec()]
+        if np.dot(dq, dq) > 1e-5:
+            error = dpose-self.J@dq
+            self.J += 0.25*np.outer(error, dq)/(np.dot(dq, dq)+1e-9)
+        self.q, self.eef, self.cam_pos, self.R = q1, eef1, cam1, R1
+        self.grip = float(grip)
+        self.seq += 1
+        if res.last.get(CAM) is not None:
+            Image.fromarray(res.last[CAM]).save(OUT / f'{self.stage}_{self.seq:03d}.jpg', quality=88)
+        self.persist()
+        if res.done:
+            raise RuntimeError(f'episode ended: {res.meta.get("reason")}')
+        print(' move', self.seq, 'eef', np.round(self.eef, 3).tolist(),
+              'q', np.round(self.q, 2).tolist(),
+              'left', round(float(res.meta.get('time_left_s', -1)), 1), flush=True)
+        return res
+
+    def move_camera(self, goal_pos, goal_R=None, grip=None, max_moves=32):
+        if goal_R is None:
+            goal_R = self.R_down
+        if grip is None:
+            grip = self.grip
+        goal_pos = np.asarray(goal_pos, dtype=float)
+        goal_R = np.asarray(goal_R, dtype=float)
+        for _ in range(max_moves):
+            dp = goal_pos-self.cam_pos
+            dr = Rotation.from_matrix(goal_R @ self.R.T).as_rotvec()
+            if np.linalg.norm(dp) < 0.012 and np.linalg.norm(dr) < 0.07:
+                print(' reached pose; residual', np.round(dp, 3).tolist(),
+                      np.round(dr, 3).tolist(), flush=True)
+                return
+            scale = min(1.0, 0.075/(np.linalg.norm(dp)+1e-12),
+                        0.18/(np.linalg.norm(dr)+1e-12))
+            err = np.r_[dp*scale, dr*scale]
+            Jw = self.J.copy()
+            err[3:] *= 0.20
+            Jw[3:] *= 0.20
+            damping = 0.035
+            dq = Jw.T @ np.linalg.solve(Jw@Jw.T+damping*damping*np.eye(6), err)
+            dq = np.clip(dq, -0.16, 0.16)
+            if np.max(np.abs(dq)) < 0.003:
+                print(' IK step too small; stopping at residual', np.round(dp, 3).tolist(), flush=True)
+                return
+            self.command(self.q+dq, grip, frames=20)
+        print(' move limit reached; residual', np.round(goal_pos-self.cam_pos, 3).tolist(), flush=True)
+
+    def move_eef(self, xyz, goal_R=None, grip=None, label=''):
+        xyz = np.asarray(xyz, dtype=float)
+        Rgoal = self.R_down if goal_R is None else np.asarray(goal_R, dtype=float)
+        camera_goal = xyz - Rgoal @ self.off_local
+        print(label, 'eef goal', np.round(xyz, 3).tolist(),
+              'camera goal', np.round(camera_goal, 3).tolist(), flush=True)
+        self.move_camera(camera_goal, Rgoal, grip=grip)
+
+    def hold_gripper(self, grip, frames=12):
+        self.command(self.q.copy(), grip, frames=frames)
+
+    def save_observation(self, tag, cameras):
+        obs = self.r.get_obs(cameras=cameras, include_depth=True, video='none')
+        obs.save(str(OUT / tag))
+        self.last_obs = obs
+        print(' saved', tag, 'time_left_s', round(float(obs.meta.get('time_left_s', -1)), 1), flush=True)
+
+
+def pan_stage(c, side, stage):
+    h = c.L[f'{side}_handle'].copy()
+    center = c.L[f'{side}_center'].copy()
+    burner = c.L[f'burn_{"left" if side == "left" else "right"}'].copy()
+    destination_handle = burner + (h-center)
+    if stage == f'approach_{side}':
+        # Move laterally above the handle, then make a short vertical approach.
+        c.move_eef([h[0], h[1], 1.22], grip=-1, label=f'{side} overhead approach')
+        c.save_observation(f'check_{side}_overhead',
+                           ['robot0_agentview_left' if side=='left' else 'robot0_agentview_right', CAM])
+    elif stage == f'descend_{side}':
+        c.move_eef([h[0], h[1], h[2]+0.015], grip=-1, label=f'{side} handle descent')
+        c.save_observation(f'check_{side}_grasp_pose',
+                           ['robot0_agentview_left' if side=='left' else 'robot0_agentview_right', CAM])
+    elif stage == f'grasp_{side}':
+        c.hold_gripper(+1, frames=16)
+        c.save_observation(f'check_{side}_closed',
+                           ['robot0_agentview_left' if side=='left' else 'robot0_agentview_right', CAM])
+    elif stage == f'lift_{side}':
+        c.move_eef([h[0], h[1], h[2]+0.16], grip=+1, label=f'{side} lift')
+        c.save_observation(f'check_{side}_lifted',
+                           ['robot0_agentview_left' if side=='left' else 'robot0_agentview_right', CAM])
+    elif stage == f'transfer_{side}':

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Visual-only controller for the live RoboCasa365 MealPrepStaging episode.

Landmark pixels below were picked from the RGB views and unprojected with the
same response's depth and camera calibration. The 6x7 seed Jacobian came from
small, safe joint perturbations measured with the robot's end-effector pose and
eye-in-hand camera calibration. The controller refreshes it online as it moves.

Run stages in order with --stage. The scene and trajectory are live; this script
does not call reset and does not read simulator object state or success flags.
"""
import argparse
import json
import pathlib
import time

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = pathlib.Path('/app/output')
STATE_FILE = OUT / 'controller_state.json'
CAM = 'robot0_eye_in_hand'
SEED_J = np.array([
    [ .0428222, -.3667058,  .0253092,  .1569523,  .0139503, -.0593817, -.0349538],
    [-.2591224, -.0018318, -.4519334,  .0027645, -.1128929,  .0007854,  .0482331],
    [ .0000358, -.2695938, -.0401327,  .4897076,  .0388222,  .1621670,  .0102143],
    [-.0007000,  .0052810,  .8673281, -.0020597, -.9404460, -.0028128, -.2844792],
    [-.0000617, -.9996843,  .0041261,  .9996623, -.0002097, 1.0005883, -.0060257],
    [ .9991476,  .0003538,  .4958349, -.0046312,  .3393329, -.0057672, -.9583755],
], dtype=float)


def unit_pose(meta):
    p = np.asarray(meta['proprio']['now'], dtype=float)
    T = np.asarray(meta['cameras'][CAM]['cam2world_gl'], dtype=float)
    return p[4:11].copy(), p[26:29].copy(), T[:3, 3].copy(), T[:3, :3].copy()


def unproject(obs, cam, uv, radius=2):
    u, v = map(int, uv)
    d = np.asarray(obs.depth[cam])[0]
    patch = d[max(0, v-radius):v+radius+1, max(0, u-radius):u+radius+1]
    zvals = patch[np.isfinite(patch) & (patch > 0)]
    if zvals.size == 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f'no depth at {cam} pixel {uv}')
    z = float(np.median(zvals))
    c = obs.meta['cameras'][cam]
    K = np.asarray(c['intrinsic_cv'], dtype=float)
    T = np.asarray(c['cam2world_gl'], dtype=float)
    ray = np.linalg.inv(K) @ np.array([u, v, 1.0])
    p_gl = np.array([ray[0]*z, -ray[1]*z, -z, 1.0])
    return (T @ p_gl)[:3]


def initial_landmarks(obs):
    # Pan centers and handles in the two side views; burners and their surface
    # heights in the overhead eye-in-hand view; corn midpoint in the left view.
    left_center = unproject(obs, 'robot0_agentview_left', (100, 150))
    left_handle = unproject(obs, 'robot0_agentview_left', (95, 176))
    right_center = unproject(obs, 'robot0_agentview_right', (220, 150))
    right_handle = unproject(obs, 'robot0_agentview_right', (254, 175))
    corn = unproject(obs, 'robot0_agentview_left', (20, 194))
    burn_left = unproject(obs, CAM, (105, 100))
    burn_right = unproject(obs, CAM, (207, 109))
    return {
        'left_center': left_center.tolist(), 'left_handle': left_handle.tolist(),
        'right_center': right_center.tolist(), 'right_handle': right_handle.tolist(),
        'corn': corn.tolist(), 'burn_left': burn_left.tolist(), 'burn_right': burn_right.tolist(),
    }


def save_state(state):
    tmp = STATE_FILE.with_suffix('.tmp')
    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2))
    tmp.replace(STATE_FILE)


class Controller:
    def __init__(self, stage):
        self.r = Robot()
        self.spec = self.r.spec()
        self.dt = float(self.spec['control_dt'])
        self.stage = stage
        self.seq = 0
        self.state = None
        if STATE_FILE.exists():
            self.state = json.loads(STATE_FILE.read_text())
        cameras = list(self.spec['cameras'])
        obs = self.r.get_obs(cameras=cameras, include_depth=True, video='none')
        self.last_obs = obs
        if self.state is None:
            q, eef, cam_pos, R = unit_pose(obs.meta)
            off_local = R.T @ (eef-cam_pos)
            self.state = {
                'landmarks': initial_landmarks(obs),
                'J': SEED_J.tolist(),
                'eef_offset_camera': off_local.tolist(),
                'down_rotation': R.tolist(),
                'created_from_observation': int(obs.meta.get('obs_id', -1)),
            }
            save_state(self.state)
        self.L = {k: np.asarray(v, dtype=float) for k, v in self.state['landmarks'].items()}
        self.J = np.asarray(self.state['J'], dtype=float)
        self.off_local = np.asarray(self.state['eef_offset_camera'], dtype=float)
        self.R_down = np.asarray(self.state['down_rotation'], dtype=float)
        self.q, self.eef, self.cam_pos, self.R = unit_pose(obs.meta)
        self.grip = -1.0
        print('stage', stage, 'steps', obs.meta.get('control_steps'),
              'time_left_s', round(float(obs.meta.get('time_left_s', -1)), 1),
              'eef', np.round(self.eef, 3).tolist(), flush=True)

    def persist(self):
        self.state['J'] = self.J.tolist()
        self.state['last_q'] = self.q.tolist()
        self.state['last_camera_position'] = self.cam_pos.tolist()
        self.state['last_rotation'] = self.R.tolist()
        save_state(self.state)

    def command(self, target_q, grip, frames=20):
        a = np.zeros((frames, 13), dtype=float)
        a[:, :7] = target_q
        a[:, 7] = float(grip)
        a[:, 12] = -1.0
        res = self.r.submit('joint_position', a, cameras=[CAM], video='none', note=self.stage)
        q1, eef1, cam1, R1 = unit_pose(res.meta)
        dq = q1-self.q
        dpose = np.r_[cam1-self.cam_pos,
                      Rotation.from_matrix(R1 @ self.R.T).as_rotvec()]
        self.q, self.eef, self.cam_pos, self.R = q1, eef1, cam1, R1
        self.grip = float(grip)
        self.seq += 1
        if res.last.get(CAM) is not None:
            Image.fromarray(res.last[CAM]).save(OUT / f'{self.stage}_{self.seq:03d}.jpg', quality=88)
        self.persist()
        if res.done:
            raise RuntimeError(f'episode ended: {res.meta.get("reason")}')
        print(' move', self.seq, 'eef', np.round(self.eef, 3).tolist(),
              'q', np.round(self.q, 2).tolist(),
              'left', round(float(res.meta.get('time_left_s', -1)), 1), flush=True)
        return res

    def move_camera(self, goal_pos, goal_R=None, grip=None, max_moves=32):
        if goal_R is None:
            goal_R = self.R_down
        if grip is None:
            grip = self.grip
        goal_pos = np.asarray(goal_pos, dtype=float)
        goal_R = np.asarray(goal_R, dtype=float)
        for _ in range(max_moves):
            dp = goal_pos-self.cam_pos
            dr = Rotation.from_matrix(goal_R @ self.R.T).as_rotvec()
            if np.linalg.norm(dp) < 0.010 and np.linalg.norm(dr) < 0.055:
                print(' reached pose; residual', np.round(dp, 3).tolist(),
                      np.round(dr, 3).tolist(), flush=True)
                return
            scale = min(1.0, 0.075/(np.linalg.norm(dp)+1e-12),
                        0.18/(np.linalg.norm(dr)+1e-12))
            err = np.r_[dp*scale, dr*scale]
            Jw = self.J.copy()
            err[3:] *= 0.20
            Jw[3:] *= 0.20
            damping = 0.04
            dq = Jw.T @ np.linalg.solve(Jw@Jw.T+damping*damping*np.eye(6), err)
            dq = np.clip(dq, -0.06, 0.06)
            if np.max(np.abs(dq)) < 0.003:
                print(' IK step too small; stopping at residual', np.round(dp, 3).tolist(), flush=True)
                return
            self.command(self.q+dq, grip, frames=20)
        print(' move limit reached; residual', np.round(goal_pos-self.cam_pos, 3).tolist(), flush=True)

    def move_eef(self, xyz, goal_R=None, grip=None, label=''):
        xyz = np.asarray(xyz, dtype=float)
        Rgoal = self.R_down if goal_R is None else np.asarray(goal_R, dtype=float)
        camera_goal = xyz - Rgoal @ self.off_local
        print(label, 'eef goal', np.round(xyz, 3).tolist(),
              'camera goal', np.round(camera_goal, 3).tolist(), flush=True)
        self.move_camera(camera_goal, Rgoal, grip=grip)

    def move_eef_position_only(self, xyz, grip=-1, max_moves=28):
        """Short visual/proprioceptive move with wrist roll held fixed."""
        goal = np.asarray(xyz, dtype=float)
        Jp = self.J[:3].copy()
        Roff = self.R @ self.off_local
        for _ in range(max_moves):
            err = goal-self.eef
            if np.linalg.norm(err) < 0.010:
                print(' reached position; residual', np.round(err, 3).tolist(), flush=True)
                return
            Je = Jp.copy()
            for j in range(7):
                Je[:, j] += np.cross(self.J[3:, j], Roff)
            Je[:, 6] = 0.0
            damping = 0.035
            dq = Je.T @ np.linalg.solve(Je@Je.T+damping*damping*np.eye(3), err)
            dq[6] = 0.0
            dq = np.clip(dq, -0.045, 0.045)
            old_eef = self.eef.copy()
            old_q = self.q.copy()
            self.command(self.q+dq, grip, frames=20)
            actual_dq = self.q-old_q
            actual_dp = self.eef-old_eef
            if np.dot(actual_dq, actual_dq) > 1e-5:
                residual = actual_dp-Je@actual_dq
                Je += 0.35*np.outer(residual, actual_dq)/(np.dot(actual_dq, actual_dq)+1e-9)
                Jp = Je.copy()
                self.J[:3] = Jp
                Roff = self.R @ self.off_local
                self.persist()
        print(' position move limit; residual', np.round(goal-self.eef, 3).tolist(), flush=True)

    def hold_gripper(self, grip, frames=12):
        self.command(self.q.copy(), grip, frames=frames)

    def save_observation(self, tag, cameras):
        obs = self.r.get_obs(cameras=cameras, include_depth=True, video='none')
        obs.save(str(OUT / tag))
        self.last_obs = obs
        print(' saved', tag, 'time_left_s', round(float(obs.meta.get('time_left_s', -1)), 1), flush=True)


def pan_stage(c, side, stage):
    h = c.L[f'{side}_handle'].copy()
    center = c.L[f'{side}_center'].copy()
    # The steak pan starts on the left; place it on the right burner. The
    # empty pan starts on the right; place it on the left burner.
    burner = c.L[f'burn_{"right" if side == "left" else "left"}'].copy()
    destination_handle = burner + (h-center)
    if stage == f'approach_{side}':
        # Move laterally above the handle, then make a short vertical approach.
        c.move_eef([h[0], h[1], 1.22], grip=-1, label=f'{side} overhead approach')
        c.save_observation(f'check_{side}_overhead',
                           ['robot0_agentview_left' if side=='left' else 'robot0_agentview_right', CAM])
    elif stage == f'descend_{side}':
        c.move_eef([h[0], h[1], h[2]+0.13], grip=-1, label=f'{side} intermediate handle descent')
        c.save_observation(f'check_{side}_precontact',
                           ['robot0_agentview_left' if side=='left' else 'robot0_agentview_right', CAM])
    elif stage == f'touch_{side}':
        c.move_eef([h[0], h[1], h[2]-0.005], grip=-1, label=f'{side} final handle descent')
        c.save_observation(f'check_{side}_grasp_pose',
                           ['robot0_agentview_left' if side=='left' else 'robot0_agentview_right', CAM])
    elif stage == f'grasp_{side}':
        c.hold_gripper(+1, frames=16)
        c.save_observation(f'check_{side}_closed',
                           ['robot0_agentview_left' if side=='left' else 'robot0_agentview_right', CAM])
    elif stage == f'lift_{side}':
        c.move_eef([h[0], h[1], h[2]+0.16], grip=+1, label=f'{side} lift')
        c.save_observation(f'check_{side}_lifted',
                           ['robot0_agentview_left' if side=='left' else 'robot0_agentview_right', CAM])
    elif stage == f'transfer_{side}':
        c.move_eef([destination_handle[0], destination_handle[1], h[2]+0.25], grip=+1,
                    label=f'{side} transfer to burner')
        c.save_observation(f'check_{side}_transfer', ['robot0_agentview_center', CAM])
    elif stage == f'place_{side}':
        c.move_eef([destination_handle[0], destination_handle[1], h[2]-0.005], grip=+1,
                    label=f'{side} lower pan')
        c.save_observation(f'check_{side}_placement',
                           ['robot0_agentview_center', CAM])
    elif stage == f'release_{side}':
        c.hold_gripper(-1, frames=16)
        c.move_eef([destination_handle[0], destination_handle[1], h[2]+0.22], grip=-1,
                    label=f'{side} release and retreat')
        c.save_observation(f'check_{side}_released',
                           ['robot0_agentview_center', CAM])
    else:
        raise ValueError(stage)


def corn_stage(c, stage):
    corn = c.L['corn'].copy()
    center = c.L['burn_left'].copy()
    right_center = c.L['right_center'].copy()
    pan_handle = c.L['right_handle'].copy()
    # Map the visible corn landmark to the empty pan's interior after that pan
    # has been moved to the right burner.
    corn_goal = center.copy()
    corn_goal[2] += 0.06
    Rcorn = Rotation.from_rotvec(np.array([0.0, 0.0, -np.pi/2])) * Rotation.from_matrix(c.R_down)
    if stage == 'approach_corn':
        c.move_eef([corn[0], corn[1], max(corn[2]+0.20, 1.12)], goal_R=Rcorn.as_matrix(),
                   grip=-1, label='corn overhead approach')
        c.save_observation('check_corn_overhead', ['robot0_agentview_left', CAM])
    elif stage == 'grasp_corn':
        c.move_eef([corn[0], corn[1], corn[2]+0.015], goal_R=Rcorn.as_matrix(),
                   grip=-1, label='corn descent')
        c.hold_gripper(+1, frames=16)
        c.save_observation('check_corn_closed', ['robot0_agentview_left', CAM])
    elif stage == 'lift_corn':
        c.move_eef([corn[0], corn[1], corn[2]+0.16], goal_R=Rcorn.as_matrix(),
                   grip=+1, label='corn lift')
    elif stage == 'transfer_corn':
        c.move_eef([corn_goal[0], corn_goal[1], corn[2]+0.16], goal_R=Rcorn.as_matrix(),
                   grip=+1, label='corn transfer to empty pan')
    elif stage == 'place_corn':
        c.move_eef([corn_goal[0], corn_goal[1], center[2]+0.08], goal_R=Rcorn.as_matrix(),
                   grip=+1, label='corn lower into pan')
    elif stage == 'release_corn':
        c.hold_gripper(-1, frames=16)
        c.move_eef([corn_goal[0], corn_goal[1], center[2]+0.28], goal_R=Rcorn.as_matrix(),
                   grip=-1, label='corn release and retreat')
        c.save_observation('check_corn_released', ['robot0_agentview_center', CAM])
    else:
        raise ValueError(stage)


def main():
    stages = [
        'approach_left', 'descend_left', 'touch_left', 'grasp_left', 'lift_left', 'transfer_left', 'place_left', 'release_left',
        'approach_right', 'descend_right', 'touch_right', 'grasp_right', 'lift_right', 'transfer_right', 'place_right', 'release_right',
        'approach_corn', 'grasp_corn', 'lift_corn', 'transfer_corn', 'place_corn', 'release_corn',
    ]
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('--stage', choices=['all', 'retract', 'touch_roll']+stages, default='all')
    args = ap.parse_args()
    c = Controller(args.stage)
    if args.stage == 'all':
        for stage in stages:
            pan_stage(c, 'left', stage) if stage.endswith('_left') else None
            if stage.endswith('_right'):
                pan_stage(c, 'right', stage)
            if stage.endswith('_corn'):
                corn_stage(c, stage)
            c.persist()
            if args.stage != 'all':
                break
    elif args.stage == 'retract':
        goal = c.eef.copy()
        goal[2] = max(goal[2]+0.25, 1.22)
        c.move_eef(goal, goal_R=c.R.copy(), grip=-1, label='vertical retreat to clearance')
        c.save_observation('after_vertical_retreat', ['robot0_agentview_center', CAM])
    elif args.stage == 'touch_roll':
        h = c.L['left_handle']
        c.move_eef_position_only([h[0], h[1], h[2]-0.005], grip=-1)
        c.save_observation('check_left_roll_grasp_pose', ['robot0_agentview_left', CAM])
    elif args.stage.endswith('_left'):
        pan_stage(c, 'left', args.stage)
    elif args.stage.endswith('_right'):
        pan_stage(c, 'right', args.stage)
    else:
        corn_stage(c, args.stage)
    print('stage complete', args.stage, 'controller state at', STATE_FILE, flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
